description: Find and BLUR sensitive text shown on screen: access tokens, API keys (sk-..., ghp_..., AKIA...), bearer tokens, JWTs, passwords and other 'token:/password:/secret:' values, emails, card numbers, and/or any phrase the user names. Scans rendered frames on-device (OCR, no upload): a first pass over the range (default: the whole video; every 0.5 s on short videos, at most 1200 frames on long ones), then every 0.5 s around everything found, so each blur starts and ends with its text and follows it when the page scrolls. Unchanged frames are not re-read, so long screen recordings stay fast. Adds every blur in ONE undo step. Long videos can take a few minutes. Use this whenever the user asks to blur/hide/censor/redact a token, key, password, email, or 'sensitive info'. Reports what was blurred and where (masked, never the secret).

name: add_sound_effect
description: Add a built-in sound effect to the timeline at a time. Great for punching up transitions, captions, reveals and jokes. No file needed - the library is built in. Pick by job. Cuts and slides: Whip, Whoosh, Swoosh, Air Swipe, Deep Whoosh, Spin, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Glitch, Static Burst. Text and captions appearing: Text Pop, Caption Tick, Pop, Blip. Build-ups: Short Riser, Riser, Snare Build, then a hit: Cinematic Hit, Boom, Sub Drop, Braam, Bass Drop. Reveals: Shimmer Reveal, Magic Wand, Drum Roll, Ta-Da, Dramatic Sting. Jokes and reactions: Vine Boom, Bonk, Rimshot, Record Scratch, Crickets, Fail, Clown Honk, Cartoon Fall. Like/subscribe and social call-outs: Like, Bell Ring, Notification, Message In, Message Sent. Wins and games: Success, Achievement, Level Up, Power Up, Coin, Game Over. Tension: Tension Drone, Ticking Clock, Heartbeat, Suspense. Foley and beds: Footsteps, Door Knock, Wind, Rain, Crowd Cheer, Applause, Keyboard.
